lead: # DELIBERATELY TWO DEPENDENCIES, both pure Rust.
# This binary is bound read-only INTO an agent's mount namespace, so every dependency is a thing
# that ships inside the cage. `bsc-util` has zero dependencies of its own and carries the shared
# decision logic; `serde_json` parses the tool payload Claude Code writes to stdin.
# It must stay this thin for two reasons. (1) The umbrella `bsc` binary is ~69 MB because it links
# ~20 subcommand crates including DuckDB — binding THAT would mean binding a writable store, the
# ambient authority the isolation exists to remove. (2) The maintainer intends to run this on
# aarch64 (Pi 4/5) and ARMv6 (Pi Zero); zero non-pure-Rust dependencies is what makes a static musl
# build for those targets a re-target rather than a port.
sections.name: [dependencies]
